'''C-9X''' was a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] designed by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. It was deployed by CEC executive [[Benton Maas]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but Imperial forces destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and took its signal emitter that could control other CEC droids, and used it to kill the CEC board.
